_meta.lumi_ref: LUM POG recommendation page: CMS LumiRecommendationsRun2, UL2017 Golden Legacy full dataset = 42.07 fb^-1 (0.82%); https://twiki.cern.ch/twiki/bin/view/CMS/LumiRecommendationsRun2
_meta.convention: cross_section_fb = target production sigma when a separate br field is used; br = separately applied decay branching ratio; kfactor = 1.0 for ALL samples currently. For generator decay-filtered / forced-decay samples stored with br=1, cross_section_fb is instead the exact sample-level effective sigma including the generator decay/filter/matching definition. sigma_eff = cross_section_fb x br x kfactor. Data: all null.
_meta.weight_formula: base_weight = lumi_fb_inv x cross_section_fb x br x kfactor / sumGenW. For base+ext datasets, sum genEventSumw across all tasks before dividing.
_meta.xsec_source: Cross sections compiled manually from CMS XSDB (https://cms-gen-dev.cern.ch/xsdb), ttHH AN-2022/122, ttH AN-19-094, the CMS GenXSec TWiki, the supplied UL2017 exact-dataset XSDB audit table (2026-06-30), and (where directly applicable) the Higgs Handbook CERN-2017-002-M. NOT auto-generated by any script.
_meta.note_counts: nevents/nfiles are per-CRAB-task; populate via das_query_counts.sh (dasgoclient summary). Extension tasks start null until filled.
_meta.note_naming: Sample keys = NtupleForge campaign config(campaign_ttHH2017UL_fullNano_v20)의 dataset key 와 1:1 동일. analyzer/configure/plotter 전부 이 이름을 사용(single source of truth = NtupleForge).
_meta.note_ttbb: tt+bb 4FS (TTbb_*) sigma=1.452 pb is INCLUSIVE; multiply decay BR once. Overlaps tt+>=1b of inclusive ttbar -> remove overlap via gen-level categorisation to avoid double counting.
_meta.note_kfactor: k-factor 는 모든 샘플 1.0. ttHH/ttZHto4b/ttZZto4b 의 Handbook/AN reference k-factor 는 이미 cross_section_fb(NLO target)에 반영돼 있으므로 별도 적용하지 않는다. 참고값은 각 엔트리 note 에 기록 (중복 적용 방지 — Guide §3.4/§10.2, CHANGELOG 권고).
_meta.note_verify: verify_xsec=true: cross_section_fb is a standard reference value to be confirmed via XSDB / GenXSecAnalyzer before final normalization. ST_s_had sigma still null.
_meta.lumi_data_certification: Recorded Golden Legacy / UL2017 Golden JSON
_meta.lumi_note: Configured 42.07 fb^-1 is the two-decimal value of the 42.0688 fb^-1 brilcalc result for the current UL2017 certified analysis JSON. Re-run brilcalc with the exact analysis JSON whenever the certified run/lumi selection or trigger selection changes. Do not use ttHH AN as the luminosity reference.
_meta.lumi_single_year_combine_nuisances: For 2017-only statistical models, LUM POG recommends lumi_13TeV_151617_l=1.0055 and lumi_13TeV_15161718_l=1.0061.
_meta.config_revision: v23: v22 exact UL2017 audit retained; tHq source strengthened with CMS AN-19-094 Table 8; tHW updated to the same AN Table 8 NLO 5FS target (15.17 fb).
_meta.note_attached_xsdb_audit: The user-supplied UL2017 exact-dataset audit table (2026-06-30) is used as provenance for TTWJetsToQQ=0.4432 pb, TTWJetsToLNu=0.2163 pb, TTZToLLNuNu_M-10=0.2439 pb, and ST_s-channel_4f_leptonDecays=3.549 pb. It also records generator/sample xsecs used only as an audit comparison for TTbar, t-channel single top, and dibosons; higher-order target normalizations remain distinct where explicitly documented.
_meta.note_tH: tHq and tHW use state-of-the-art NLO-QCD target cross sections for normalization while retaining their generated LO 4FS/5FS event kinematics. CMS AN-19-094 Table 8 explicitly follows this convention for the 2017 datasets: tHq=0.07425 pb and tHW=0.01517 pb.

tHq.xsec_ref: Higgs Handbook CERN-2017-002-M Table 235 (PDF p.764, printed p.744): sigma_NLO_QCD(tH+anti-tH, 13 TeV, mH=125 GeV, 5FS)=74.25 fb; CMS AN-19-094 Table 8: the 2017 THQ_ctcvcp_4f_Hincl sample is normalized to SM sigma=0.07425 pb (NLO); ttHH AN-2022/122 Table 9 is retained only as the ttHH analysis cross-section context and has no tHq row.
tHq.note: THQ_ctcvcp_4f_Hincl LO 4FS events are normalized to the more precise 13 TeV NLO 5FS inclusive target 74.25 fb. This is independently implemented in CMS AN-19-094 Table 8 for the same 2017 4FS dataset. The scheme/order mismatch concerns event shapes, not the validity of a global target normalization. Handbook Table-235 K_QCD=1.20 is NOT applied separately because cross_section_fb already stores the NLO target.
tHq.normalization_scope: inclusive t-channel tH+anti-tH theory target; H-inclusive
tHq.analysis_reference: CMS AN-19-094 Table 8 (tHq 2017 4FS sample, sigma=0.07425 pb NLO); ttHH AN-2022/122 Table 9 is general companion context only.
